review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Compute
review_candidates.description: Engineering London Full Time Software Engineer, Compute Careers / Engineering Engineering London Full Time About Vercel Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About The Role Developers are building faster than ever. Humans and agents are deploying more than 6 million times a day on Vercel, spinning up over 2 million Sandboxes and serving a trillion requests per month. Every single one is powered by our own compute infrastructure . The Persistence team sits within Vercel's Compute division. This team owns the deep infrastructure within Hive (our compute platform) focussing on storage and state for all our workloads (Builds, Sandboxes and Functions). This work is redefining compute with features like Fluid Compute, Persistent Sandboxes, and Custom Images. As a Software Engineer on the Persistence team, you'll work on the infrastructure that runs 100s of instances across every region where our customers deploy code, rethinking low-level primitives and contributing to platform features that improve the experience for thousands of developers every day. This role is based in London, UK . If you're within commuting distance of our London office, the role includes in-office anchor days. If you're located further afield within the UK, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do Manage and improve our fleet of clusters, running 100s of instances deployed in every region where our customers deploy and run their code. Write Golang on a daily basis and use Terraform to provision infrastructure; you'll get to know Nomad as our scheduler for managing workloads. Rethink the primitives of our infrastructure — working with virtual filesystems, Linux primitives, and low-level virtualisation. Own the reliability and performance of our compute platform, including on-call coverage for a team where every improvement has outsized impact at scale. Collaborate across teams to drive the convergence of all compute at Vercel. About You 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Golang strongly preferred. Deep experience with virtual machines, file systems and Linux — you like knowing how things work under the hood (tcpdump, strace, and iptables are familiar tools). Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale; you design for performance and reliability. Experience with schedulers and orchestrators for managing containers and non-containerised workloads (e.g. Nomad, Kubernetes). Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with a genuine enthusiasm for digging into problems that don't have obvious solutions. Bonus If You Have worked on low-level virtualisation or sandbox execution environments. Have product engineering experience and care about the developer-facing impact of infrastructure decisions. Have experience with on-call operations for large-scale distributed systems. Benefits Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. Disclosures Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description. Apply Now. Tell us why you’d be a good fit for the Software Engineer, Compute role. review_candidates.title: Senior Storage Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. Senior Storage Software Engineer About The Role We are looking for an experienced Storage Software Engineer with 12-15 years of software engineering experience to design, architect, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms in Kubernetes environments. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role that combines systems programming, distributed systems, storage architecture, and cloud-native technologies. You will be responsible for building production-grade storage software with a strong focus on performance, scalability, reliability, availability, and data durability. The ideal candidate can take complex storage challenges end-to-end—from architecture and design to coding, testing, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and production deployment—while collaborating with other engineers to continuously evolve and strengthen the storage platform. Responsibilities Design and develop distributed Block, File, and Object Storage systems. Architect highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-performance storage platforms. Write and review production-quality code using C/C++ and/or Go. Build Kubernetes-native storage solutions, including CSI, controllers, operators, and APIs. Develop and optimize storage data-plane and control-plane components. Lead architecture development and solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems and domains. Define the future state and technical roadmap of the storage platform, balancing near-term delivery with long-term scalable architecture. Identify common patterns and build reusable technology solutions rather than solving only individual use cases. Drive modernization of the technology stack and influence adoption of new architectures and technologies across teams. Proactively identify design gaps related to performance, security, reliability, availability, failover, recovery, maintainability, and scalability. Lead architecture and design reviews and create high-quality technical and architecture documentation. Mentor engineers and raise the technical and engineering standards of the broader team. Debug complex issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and storage layers. What You’ll Do Lead complex engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams, systems, and technical domains. Shape technical strategy and help translate long-term product vision into an executable engineering roadmap. Use AI coding agents to your advantage to boost productivity and lead us to the future of AI native engineering. Capable of giving the right context and detailed requirements to the Agent. Shepherd multiple teams through architecture, development, testing, and production delivery. Act as an engineering multiplier by building reusable platforms, frameworks, tools, and processes. Influence technical direction beyond the immediate team and advocate for solutions that can be adopted broadly. Balance incremental improvements with transformational architectural changes when appropriate. Drive technology decisions that result in measurable improvements in reliability, performance, scalability, engineering velocity, and customer experience. Take ownership of business and customer outcomes rather than simply executing predefined requirements. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s or Master degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering. Strong software engineering experience in storage and/or distributed systems. Proficiency in C/C++, Go, or Rust Strong understanding of Linux, concurrency, networking, and storage I/O. Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures. Knowledge of technologies such as NVMe, iSCSI, NFS, S3, SPDK, CSI, UBD. Our existing production services are written in Go, and you'll maintain and evolve them alongside new development Solid experience designing and operating microservices: API design (REST/gRPC), service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication patterns Production experience with AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, CloudFront, RDS, ElastiCache or equivalents) and containerised deployments on Kubernetes Hands-on experience with data stores and search: relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), OpenSearch/Elasticsearch and Redis, including schema design, indexing strategy and query performance tuning Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing (Kafka, SQS or similar) Strong grounding in observability and reliability: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, SLOs and incident management Nice to have Experience integrating AI/LLM-backed features into production services (e.g. AWS Bedrock, prompt-serving infrastructure, latency and cost optimisation for model calls) Experience with edge computing (Lambda@Edge, CDN-level logic) and multi-region considerations Experience with frontend tooling at scale: monorepos (e.g. Turborepo), design systems, and frontend testing (Jest, Playwright) Experience with SEO-critical web applications, internationalisation and right-to-left (Arabic) layouts Exposure to billing/subscription systems, identity platforms, or geospatial/location data Experience in marketplace, classifieds, or other two-sided platform products How You Work You take ownership beyond your ticket: you notice problems, propose solutions and follow through You communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and back your arguments with data You hold a high bar in code review and design review, and you make the engineers around you better You're pragmatic: you know when to build for scale and when to ship the simple thing, and you can quantify the cost of both Our promise to talent At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Software Engineer Osprey Flight Solutions · Full-time · Remote, home-based · Reports to Head of Engineering Why this role, why now Aviation security teams and airline operators make real decisions off what Osprey's platform tells them, so the software behind it has to be right. You'd join a lean, six-person engineering team spanning front-end, back-end and DevOps/platform, small enough that what you build actually ships, rather than queuing behind layers of process. We've recently closed a £40 million growth investment and are building out engineering to match, so you'd be joining while the codebase and the team are still small enough to shape. This is a genuinely remote role, not remote-with-conditions. What you'll be doing Play a key role in delivering new product capability as part of a small team that ships on time, at quality. Support what's already live: investigate and resolve support desk issues within SLA, and own contained pockets of technical debt, escalating the harder cases to technical leadership. Give informed estimates on everything from fully scoped work to raw ideas, and flag blockers early rather than sitting on them. Help shape what gets built next, contributing to PRDs, technical feasibility testing and prototyping during discovery. Design solutions that fit Osprey's reference architecture, and take the more complex proposals to the technical design authority. Break work into small, shippable pieces with your team, and take planned production changes through change management, so you can show you release safely. Support less senior engineers around you, and bring genuine empathy for how end users actually use what you build, backed by solid test automation. Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering and DevOps when a deliverable calls for it. What you'll bring Commercial full-stack development experience; Osprey's stack centres on .NET, C# and React. Experience delivering in an Agile, SaaS environment. A track record of adapting well when priorities or requirements shift. Clear, concise communication, written and verbal. Comfort working independently and delivering sustained value with minimal supervision. Even better if you have Exposure to aviation, security, InsurTech or another data-intensive B2B SaaS domain. Experience mentoring or supporting less senior engineers. Comfort presenting technical proposals to a design authority or similarly rigorous review process. A summary of what’s on offer Holiday : 25 days’ paid annual leave plus bank holidays. Pension : Osprey matches your contribution at 4% of gross basic salary (on top of your own 4%) via the Smart Pension scheme, with an optional salary sacrifice arrangement that saves on National Insurance for both sides. Private healthcare: Comprehensive AXA cover from the end of probation, including inpatient/day-patient treatment, cancer cover, a 24/7 virtual GP, a health support line, and cashback on dental (up to £400/year) and optical (up to £200/year) costs. Life insurance : A tax-free lump sum of up to 4x basic salary from the end of probation, with an employee assistance programme, virtual GP access and will-writing support. Financial wellbeing: Free access to Lifetime, a financial coaching app with a personal wellbeing coach, an annual financial plan and educational tools, plus optional access to a regulated financial advisor. Family-friendly policies: Maternity, paternity/secondary carer, adoption and shared parental leave, fertility and IVF support, flexible working, and carer’s/emergency leave. Other perks: Cycle to Work scheme, an eyecare contribution through the AXA plan, professional membership and subscription fees paid where relevant to the role, and a £1,500 referral bonus once the person you refer completes probation.
